environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-west-2 VPC. Task execution role arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/svc-records-task-role with inline policy. DynamoDB table 'user_records' has a leading key condition policy attached to the task role using dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition. The IAM policy on the task role includes a Condition block with ForAllValues:StringEquals on dynamodb:LeadingKeys set to ${aws:PrincipalTag/sub}, and the task role has a session tag propagation from the OIDC provider that sets aws:PrincipalTag/sub to the authenticated user's subject claim at token exchange time via IAM Roles Anywhere with a trust policy condition. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a resource policy with an explicit Deny for any principal whose dynamodb:LeadingKeys does not match the partition key being accessed. Container runs with read-only root filesystem and drops all capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE.

config.session_tag_source: IAM Roles Anywhere trust policy with X.509 certificate subject mapping to aws:PrincipalTag/sub from mTLS client cert CN
config.table_resource_policy: Explicit Deny if dynamodb:LeadingKeys != caller partition key
config.container_security: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, drop ALL, add NET_BIND_SERVICE
config.network: Internal ALB, private subnet, no internet egress
